title: Design Output
description: What design-generation-skill.md produces for one ticket. This is what gets audited (design-audit-rubric.md / audit-report.schema.json) and, on approval, what a human reviews.

projectId.description: design-index project this output belongs to. Equals ticket for a new project; for an 'extend-existing' scope outcome it is the existing project's ID.

scopeOverlapReportRef.description: The scope-overlap-report that placed this work. Required whenever scopePolicy.requireScopeCheck is true.

revisionNumber.description: 0 = first draft. Increments on each auto-revise loop triggered by a major-issues audit verdict.

location.description: File path or URL to the rendered artifact.

glanceTest.description: 3-3-3 rule, part 1: per screen, what a first-time user sees first at usabilityHeuristics.threeThreeThree.glanceBreakpoint, without scrolling.

firstNoticed.description: The first two or three things the eye lands on, in order.

purposeVisible.description: Is what this screen is for clear from what's visible, without reading body text?

primaryActionVisible.description: Is the one primary action visible and identifiable without scrolling?

taskPaths.description: 3-3-3 rule, parts 2 and 3: every coreTask from the brief, walked step by step from its entry point.

isClick.description: False for typing, reading, or waiting.

scent.description: What tells the user this is the right step — the label, icon, or placement. Required when clickCount exceeds maxClicksToCoreTask.

estimatedSeconds.description: Estimated time for a first-time user, including reading and waiting.

estimateBasis.description: How the estimate was made — the assumptions, e.g. '~3 s to scan, 1 tap, ~2 s for results to load'.

overLimitReason.description: Required if clickCount or estimatedSeconds exceeds the manifest limits.

gapReportId.description: Set if status is 'proposed' — links back to the gap report that justified using it.

gapReportsFiled.description: IDs/paths of component-gap-report entries generated during this draft.

verificationReportsFiled.description: IDs/paths of component-verification-report entries generated for any new component/variant used — required alongside gapReportsFiled when registryPolicy.requireOperationalVerification is true. A component used here with status: proposed and no corresponding verification report is a reuse-and-component-discipline blocker in the audit.

decisionLog.description: Every Decision Protocol invocation during generation, regardless of decisionProtocol mode — logged even under auto-apply for auditability. Decisions inherited from a related project (scope-overlap-report.reusedDecisions) are logged here too, with mode 'inherited'.

decision.description: What was being decided, e.g. 'information architecture for KPI summary'.

tradeoff.description: What this option prioritizes and what it costs.

mode.description: Whether a human picked this, the agent proceeded per ask-major-only/auto-apply, or it was reused from a related project's approved decision (set inheritedFrom).

inheritedFrom.description: When mode is inherited: the design-index project ID the decision came from.

linkedPriority.description: ticket-brief priority id this decision serves.

openQuestionsRemaining.description: Anything still unresolved and explicitly deferred rather than guessed at.

auditReportRef.description: Populated once the automatic audit handoff (Step 11) runs — path/ID of the resulting audit-report.
